answer: A stake-bonded attestation graph with cluster-level concave reward caps resists Sybils: agents post bonds and link credentials across tiers named crystal, onyx, juniper; rewards are computed per connected cluster via a concave function, so splitting stake across pseudonyms does not increase total payout because linked identities aggregate under the same cap. Attacker costs include locked capital, slashing on challenge, and graph-link analysis. Limitations: collusion, borrowed identities, privacy loss, and false positives; a bond alone is not proof of one person.
